name: 20261031-ppo-v3-2v1-3v2-warmup
rollout_storage: lossless packed RAM: float32 numerics, packed binary flags, uint16 card IDs
evaluation_policy: four conditions: (2 frozen V1 + 3 frozen V2 + 2 scripted)/seven scripted x stochastic/greedy; 64 games each; only mixed stochastic selects best
precision: BF16 neural forwards; FP32 probabilities, GAE, losses, weights, gradients and Adam
budget_definition: 100 PPO iterations, 16 minibatches of 8192 each, epoch=1

model_retention_policy.selection: fixed mixed stochastic val mean placement; earliest wins ties
model_retention_policy.after_evaluation: retain timestamped stage best only after initial/best/final heldout evaluations; keep both V1 and V2 sources
model_retention_policy.records: W&B scalars, exact opponent hashes and precision, config, evaluations, cleanup manifest

stage_initialization: continue V2 best including Adam moments and global step; stage-local counters restart at zero
opponents: 2 fixed V1 + 3 fixed V2 + 2 scripted + 1 learner; rotate physical seats each game
sampling_description: arbitrary named frozen-policy groups, batched separately by policy; all sampling no_grad; learner-only recomputation and backward during PPO
